scripts.db:migrate: sh -c 'if [ -f ../../.env ]; then dotenv -e ../../.env -- prisma migrate deploy; else prisma migrate deploy; fi'
scripts.db:migrate:dev: sh -c 'if [ -f ../../.env ]; then dotenv -e ../../.env -- prisma migrate dev; else prisma migrate dev; fi'
scripts.db:seed: sh -c 'if [ -f ../../.env ]; then dotenv -e ../../.env -- tsx src/seed.ts; else tsx src/seed.ts; fi'
